policy: Authored candidate coverage, not measured geometry or damage authority

profiles.rationale: Initial NVO authoring proposal: body gear may protect portions of torso and limbs. This does not make all fabric equivalent to a plate, assign coverage fractions, or identify a struck surface. Mesh/material review remains pending. No head protection from this item.
Initial NVO authoring proposal: the helmet protects part of the head. A coarse head hit does not establish helmet versus exposed face. No other body region receives coverage.
